subject: 2026-10-12-amazon-decart-acquisition-talks
text:
Brief says: "For banks, the deal is worth watching as AI infrastructure software changes hands." (note)
Source says: "Decart's Lucy model, backed by Nvidia, can edit live video in real time, according to the company's website. It has also developed Oasis, a model that generates simulated environments to train and test robotics and autonomous-driving systems." (https://www.ksl.com/article/51635095/amazon-in-talks-to-buy-ai-startup-decart-for-around-7-billion-wsj-reports)
Suggested fix: "The figure comes from the Journal's report, and talks can still fall apart. For banks, the deal is worth watching as models for live-video editing and robotics simulation change hands." (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
